gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-imperial-a: Flat, stencil-cut and tightly packed. Bevellier's graceful heading letters sit over Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic, a sans whose open-mouthed c and short capital step keep paragraphs approachable line after line.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-inscriptio: Bevellier gives the heading a stencil-cut look, with single-weight strokes and a wide-looking lowercase with squat ascenders. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian, with big open eyes, takes over below.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-jp: Sleek, stencil-cut and close-fitted, Bevellier draws every arm and leg at a constant width. Its strongest quality is how that flat, graceful heading meets Noto Sans JP, a plain sans with a very tall x-height and sweeping open curves.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Graceful, first of all, describes Bevellier, which draws flat, stencil-cut heads with thick-only outlines and tight sidebearings. Noto Sans Kaithi does the opposite job, a plain sans whose open e and line-filling lowercase make text feel contemporary and easy to follow.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: A flat, stencil-cut heading from Bevellier, drawn with one fixed nib width and sidebearings packed tight, sits above Noto Sans Kayah Li. Quiet text, sharp heading.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Noto Sans Kharoshthi is a plain sans with curves that never close and a thick, dark band of lowercase, set under Bevellier's signage-plain stencil heading. Both stay friendly and flat.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Sophisticated and stencil-cut, Bevellier keeps a pen-like line of constant weight. Its strongest quality is the way that tightly spaced heading lets Noto Sans Khmer, a plain sans with chisel-notch openings and near-capital small letters, feel generous by comparison.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Noto Sans Khojki has exits wide enough to pass light, and a large eye on every e. Under Bevellier's stencil-cut heading, whose horizontals are no thinner than its verticals, a long page of text would feel open, clear and modern.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Noto Sans Khudawadi keeps capitals and lowercase close in height, with unsealed rounds like an unlatched hook. And Bevellier's bent-paperclip heading, with no swelling anywhere, gives that plain sans a flat, tightly spaced, graceful head.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-kr: A y whose tail matches its arm in thickness marks Bevellier, flat and stencil-cut with tight sidebearings. Noto Sans KR keeps generous curve gaps and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height, so shrinking the heading would blur Bevellier's stencil cuts.
